obligations.feature: Row status icon from workspace state, then the sessions' aggregated status, then PR state, else branch/local (not the manual Backlog/In progress status, which only groups the status-grouped sidebar)
obligations.gap: On 66a892a the row icon follows Conductor's chain: rowStatus({workspaceState: ws.state, session, pr: ws.pr}). #370 closed two gaps: the session status is now aggregated over every chat of the workspace (reasonChat chatStatuses -> workspaceSessionStatus, nTr order), and every on-screen row polls its PR every 5 minutes like Conductor's G5e (sidebarPrPoll.ts / sidebarPrPoller.ts, batched per repository), so PR states reach rows that are not open and come back after a restart once the row is on screen. Still missing: the chat queue's SessionStatus is only idle/working/cancelling/error, so needs_plan_response, needs_user_permission, needs_user_input and waiting never reach the icon.
obligations.done_when: the gap in `why` is closed and the feature matches the cited evidence end to end
